protocol: chronological retrospective robustness extension; no model tuning
schedule_source: SKU first observation and active combinations in first 7 days inferred retrospectively
training_rule: other non-held-out SKUs whose seven-day label is complete at target first_seen
limitations: same simulated dataset; not an independent external test
launch schedule and assortment inferred retrospectively
no verified planned price or promotion
earliest launches excluded by stated minimum-history rule
sparse daily records not imputed; no production demand guarantee
bootstrap does not model temporal dependence between fitted training sets
baseline: mean category/channel/region; fallback category, channel/region, global
selection_rule: all non-reserved SKU launches with >=10 completed prior non-reserved SKU launch windows

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%, conditional on observed SKUs
